summary: Make JSONStorage write db.json keys sorted by default, with an opt-out, so committed fixture diffs stop being noisy. Only an initial look at the code has been recorded.
narrative: The owner asked for JSONStorage to write sorted keys by default because committed db.json fixtures produce noisy diffs when key order shifts, while keeping a way to turn sorting off. The only recorded work is an early observation (#1) that sort_keys is currently passed through kwargs with no default in tinydb/storages.py. No implementation, PR or release is recorded yet.

milestones.text: Owner asked for sorted keys by default in JSONStorage, with an opt-out, to reduce fixture diff noise.
Explored storages.py: sort_keys is only passed via kwargs, with no default sorting.
